title: Count Even and Odd Numbers
statement: Given an integer array nums, return how many values are even and how many are odd.
think: What is the task asking? Count numbers in two categories: even and odd.
What is the key operation? Check each number with modulo 2.
What wording signals stand out? Count, even, odd.
What is the brute force idea? There is no need for anything beyond a simple pass.
What is the better/optimal idea? Use one pass and two counters.
What are the edge cases? Empty-like arrays, all even, all odd, negative values.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I iterate once and classify each number using n % 2.
interview: I would solve it with a single pass through the array. For each number, I check whether it is divisible by two and update the even or odd counter.
ru: Это очень базовая задача: идём по массиву и делим числа на две группы по условию num % 2 == 0.
visualExplanation:
nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
1 -> odd
2 -> even
3 -> odd
4 -> even
5 -> odd
result = even:2, odd:3

important: Forget that negative even numbers are still even
nice: Do not explain why this is O(1) space

gaps: Important: be comfortable with simple array scans
Nice to have: explain parity check clearly
constraints: Assume the array length is small to medium.
whyThisPattern: This is a Linear Scan problem because the solution is just one pass with a simple per-element condition.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because we do not need mapping or frequencies.
Not Two Pointers, because we are not rearranging the array.
